name: MajlisAlpha UAE AED Scenario Lab
purpose: Convert UAE disclosures, macro drivers, ownership signals, corporate actions, and source-backed company evidence into auditable AED valuation scenarios.
scenarioPolicy: No scenario should be exported unless each material assumption has source provenance, date, sensitivity range, affected ticker, owner, reviewer status, and unresolved gap handling.
workflow: pull evidence from disclosures, macro, ownership, corporate action, and peer modules
record each material assumption with source URL and evidence date
run sensitivity range and affected metric mapping
route weak assumptions to claim trace, quality, portfolio, or compliance workflow
mark scenario export-ready only after reviewer approval

escalationRules.condition: assumption lacks official source URL or evidence date
escalationRules.action: mark blocked and assign Source Refresh Scheduler owner

escalationRules.condition: scenario changes valuation range or committee recommendation language
escalationRules.action: route to Answer Quality Lab and Claim Trace Inspector

escalationRules.condition: scenario depends on a corporate action, ownership change, or macro driver
escalationRules.action: link back to the relevant tracker before export

escalationRules.condition: scenario may sound like investment advice
escalationRules.action: send to Compliance Audit Center and keep export not share-ready

launchGate.readyRule: AED Scenario Lab is pilot-ready when every exported scenario has ticker, scenario type, assumption provenance, official URL, evidence date, sensitivity range, affected metrics, owner, reviewer status, and unresolved gaps.
launchGate.blockedRule: If a material assumption is unsourced, stale, unreviewed, or missing sensitivity range, the valuation scenario cannot be marked export-ready.
